activity.name: What is End of Life Palliative Care?
activity.description: Palliative Care Fundamentals — Module 1. Introduces the WHO definition of palliative care, the five phases and six layers of end of life support, the GMC & NICE 12-month definition, common myths and misconceptions, and a reflective exercise on the impact of language in end of life conversations.

activity.name: Apply the Criteria — Patient Vignettes
activity.description: Three patient vignettes assessed against the GMC & NICE 12-month definition of "approaching end of life".
